history.sg_progress: UNIFIL confirmed that it had rebroadcast the policy on travel requests and had informed all parties involved regarding their responsibilities with regard to the mandatory process. MINUJUSTH is also preparing an information circular to remind all staff and non-staff members of the need to comply with the travel policy. The deployment of the standardized justification codes is expected by the end of the first quarter of 2018. In line with the current Umoja design, this field will be mandatory for any travel request created less than 21 days prior to the start date of planned travel. Should additional delays be encountered during the approval processes, this will be captured post facto in compliance reporting through business intelligence systems.
